free_tier.stated: Free Forever: 2 GB transfer with 7-day retention, plus 2 GB of BLAZE Drive storage, 2 workspaces, 2 upload portals. Starter €6/user/mo: 100 GB transfer / 30-day retention / 100 GB Drive.

retention.stated: Free Forever: 2 GB transfer with 7-day retention, plus 2 GB of BLAZE Drive storage, 2 workspaces, 2 upload portals

tooling: No public API or CLI found. Account-gated workspace product (quantum-safe E2EE suite: Transfer + Drive + Notes + Messaging).
chaining: 2 free workspaces x 2 GB — trivial volume, and the transfer allowance and Drive storage are separate small pools. Nothing here multiplies.
limits_note: per-object-cap: 2 GB transfer, 7-day retention on free. The 2 GB Drive is permanent but tiny. Workspace count (2) is the multiplication lever and it is too small to matter.
reliability_note: Its marketing page claims 'No size limits' for Transfer while its own pricing page says 2 GB — a direct contradiction within the same site. Trust the pricing page.

evidence.proved: 'Free Forever ... 2GB transfer / 7-day retention, 2GB BLAZE Drive storage, 2 free workspaces'
